simple.summary: כָּפַף (kâphaph) means to curve First listed occurrence: Isa 58 5.

definitions.full: H3721. kaphaph כָּפַף verb bend, bend down, be bent, bowed (Late Hebrew bend, overturn , Assyrian kapâpu, bend , bow , Dl HWB 347 ; Arabic fell a seam, also turn back, avert , selvage , circuit, rim ; Aramaic כְפַף bend, curve ; Palmyrene כפתא niche , from כפף curve according to Vog No. 70, p. 50 ); — Qal Perfect ׳כ נַפְשִׁי Psa 57:7 my soul is bowed down; Infinitive construct (transitive) ראֹשׁוֺ כְּאַגְמֹן לָכֹף Isa 58:5 to bend down, like a rush, his head. Passive participle (הַ)כְּפוּפִים those bowed down , in distress, humiliation, etc., Psa 145:14 ; 146:8 . Niph`al Imperfect 1singular לֵאלֹהֵי אִכַּף מָרוֺם Micah 6:6 with what shall I bow myself (in worship) toward the high God ?
